name: Vintage — the point-in-time tape
one_liner: Stop overwriting: append every daily bhavcopy row and every changed fundamentals value with observed_at, so screens, backtests and briefs can run 'as of' any date on a survivorship-free universe the user's own machine recorded.
rides_on: sidecar/services/nse_bhavcopy.py:92-101 (date-addressable archive URL, 7-day cache that forgets)
sidecar/services/fundamentals_store.py:122-123,473-484 (one row per symbol, ON CONFLICT upsert)
sidecar/services/bse_provider.py:155-163 (accidental raw BSE archive outside the data dir)
new_parts: eod_bars table (trade_date, symbol, series) appended in bhavcopy_refresh_once
fund_obs change-data-capture table on non-price-derived fields
wake-time gap backfill by missing trade date
as_of parameter on screener_run + 'as of' chip on the screener panel
bundled 1-year eod_bars seed; storage row + compaction switch in Settings
risk: Fundamentals are PIT only from install day forward; must be labeled 'observed since <date>' or it becomes the lie it exists to prevent. Archive backfill depth unprobed; bhavcopy format changes must write a visible gap, never a silent empty day.

name: Drift Ledger — the number changed, and here is who changed it
one_liner: Detect when a vendor silently revises a historical value (no new fiscal period, no filing, no corporate action), and show which saved screens and published brief claims flip because of it.
new_parts: drift classifier: explained-by-filing / explained-by-corporate-action / unexplained vendor revision
impact join over saved screens + claims
drift card + receipts view (both observations, timestamps, providers)
per-field tolerance bands + fixture suite of benign drifts
risk: False alarms on legitimate TTM rolls get it muted; the 'period did not advance' test must be strict and unexplained-only the default.

name: Honesty Card + Trial Ledger
one_liner: Every backtest ships a deterministic audit — next-open fill delta, data-basis mix, India cost realism, volume participation, survivorship flag, sample size — plus a persisted count of how many variants were tried on that symbol set, deflating the headline Sharpe.
new_parts: honesty block on BacktestResult (look-ahead delta, basis, costs, participation, survivorship, n)
SQLite trial ledger keyed by hash(symbol set, window) + deflated/haircut Sharpe as a banded verdict
dated India fee preset (STT, stamp duty, exchange + GST, brokerage)
card fed to strategy_critic through backtest_summary
census note: equity curve is per bar not per day (backtest_engine.py:313,391-397) so multi-symbol metrics are mis-annualised today
risk: Deflation maths shown with false precision; ship a banded verdict (anecdote / suggestive / robust) with the formula one click away. Statutory charges change with budgets.

name: Incubator — frozen rules with a tamper-evident out-of-sample record
one_liner: Freeze any saved screen or DSL rule; the terminal evaluates it every session (replaying missed days deterministically on wake) into an append-only, hash-chained signal log and reports in-sample vs out-of-sample decay. It scores; it never proposes or places anything.
rides_on: sidecar/models/audit_log.py:40-46 (append-only trigger idiom — copied into a NEW db, §6.5 files untouched)
new_parts: frozen-rule store {rule_hash, frozen_at, definition, evaluator_version}
signal_log table with append-only triggers + previous-row hash
wake-time deterministic replay stamped replayed_on_wake; next-open booking
Incubator tab in the backtest panel; incubator_status read capability
names kept outside the place_/submit_/execute_ grep gate
risk: A forward record gets read as advice; needs n and dispersion beside every number. Evaluator changes must refuse to continue an old rule rather than re-interpret it.

name: Rule Forge — event studies from any predictive sentence
one_liner: A predictive claim in a brief gets a flask button: the LLM drafts a typed EventSpec once, the user approves it, and a deterministic event study over exchange disclosures returns CAR, n, t-stat, hit rate, top-3 contribution and the filing behind every event — usually concluding 'not distinguishable from noise'.
rides_on: quant-1 tape, quant-3 trial ledger, quant-4 freeze
new_parts: event-study engine (pure python statistics): timestamp-to-tradable-session, market-adjusted CAR, dispersion, contribution
EventSpec type + approval through the proposed-changes gate
announcement category map with a visible 'unclassified' bucket + fixtures
accruing cross-sectional announcement archive
event_study read capability
risk: Cross-sectional announcement history per category is unprobed (current fetcher is per-symbol, nse_provider.py:575-594); with thin history the honest product is an anecdote detector for the first months.

name: Action Chain — auditable corporate-action adjustment
one_liner: Parse the bonus/split/rights rows the code already fetches and discards into a per-symbol factor chain, corroborate each factor against the tape's own ex-date discontinuity, and derive adjusted series locally with one receipt per factor and an as-traded/adjusted toggle.
new_parts: subject-string parser (bonus/split/rights) with a fixture file of real 2026 subjects + visible 'unparsed action' list
factor-chain store; one-witness factors shown amber, never silently applied
locally derived adjusted series + chart basis toggle + ex-date markers
BSE corporate-actions lane for BSE-only scrips (none in code today)
risk: Semantics of PrvsClsgPric on an ex-date must be verified against three known 2026 actions before it is trusted as a witness; rights and demergers will sometimes be unparseable and must show as unresolved.

name: Factor X-ray — your portfolio is one trade
one_liner: Cross-sectional percentile ranks (value, quality, momentum, size, low-vol, delivery %) over the whole India store give every holding and the whole book a factor exposure strip with stated coverage, and a daily watch that speaks up when an exposure crosses an extreme.
rides_on: sidecar/services/nse_bhavcopy.py:22-30 (legacy bhavcopy carries delivery columns BhavRow drops)
quant-1 tape for momentum / volatility / turnover legs
new_parts: rank computation (SQL window functions) with frozen, versioned factor definitions
factor_exposure read capability (projects to agent + MCP via the catalog)
exposure strip on the portfolio panel with coverage + data_as_of
threshold watch on the daily loop
risk: Ranks launder vendor errors into confident percentiles; thin BSE-only coverage must render as 'unranked', never as the 50th percentile.

name: Surprise without analysts — SUE + drift watch for uncovered names
one_liner: Seasonal-random-walk standardised earnings surprise from the company's own quarterly history (no consensus needed), triggered off the results calendar for holdings and watchlist, with after-hours-aware first tradable print and an automatically frozen drift tracker.
new_parts: SUE computation + sigma bar against 8 quarters
results-evening trigger on the daily loop and on wake
two-source gate (filing PDF + vendor quarterly) or 'single-source, provisional' label
consolidated/standalone pinning per company
risk: A mis-extracted PAT from a results PDF yields a confident wrong sigma; every figure needs a page receipt and a 'could not read the filing' fallback. Floor-adjacent (results-day signals).

name: Thesis CI — a thesis compiles into tests
one_liner: The LLM runs once to turn a written thesis into screener-formula assertions the user approves; after that they are evaluated deterministically and for free on every new observation or shareholding filing, and a failing assertion links to the filing that failed it.
new_parts: thesis-assertion store (formula + symbol + field-vocabulary version)
new formula fields: pledge %, promoter %, QoQ deltas
pass/fail badge beside the ticker + failing-assertion receipt
compiler must answer 'this part is not testable' for qualitative clauses
risk: Qualitative theses do not compile; inventing a proxy would be worse than declining. Field renames break stored theses without versioning. Floor-adjacent (thesis vs filings); the twist is zero LLM cost at check time.
